instruction: Apply a tag label to every email in the Bills folder

rules.sql: select (select count(distinct messageID) from messageAttributes where attributeID >= 64 and attributeID <= 68 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13)) = (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) and (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) > 0;

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a tag label to all emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13). The evaluator checks if every email in folder 13 has a tag attribute (attributeID 64-68 represent different tag labels) set to 1 by verifying that the count of tagged emails equals the total count of emails in the folder. This is verified via SQL query on the Thunderbird global-messages-db.sqlite database.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails in Bills folder have tags by comparing count of distinct tagged messages with total message count
Query logic: count(distinct messageID with tags) = count(all messages in folder) ensures complete coverage
Properly handles edge case of empty folder with additional check: count(*) > 0
Uses count(distinct messageID) which correctly handles cases where a single email might have multiple tag attributes
AttributeID range 64-68 covers all possible tag labels in Thunderbird
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird to ensure database consistency before reading
